context: Riku and Aoi chat about a day trip to Shinjuku.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ベッド/タイミング/新宿/高校生/解放) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 週末、新宿に遊びに行ったよ!
lines.en: I went out to Shinjuku on the weekend!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、新宿は人が多いでしょ?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、でもいいタイミングで空いてたよ。
lines.en: Yeah, but at a good timing it was empty.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 高校生だと、テスト明けは解放感あるよね。
lines.en: For a high schooler, post-exams feels liberating, huh.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そう、テストから解放されて最高だった!
lines.en: Yeah, freed from exams, it was the best!
lines.style: thrilled teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 帰って、ベッドで爆睡したでしょ?
lines.en: You crashed in bed when you got home, right?
lines.style: giggly barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、ベッドに倒れこんだよ。
lines.style: laughing teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今度は、タイミング合わせて一緒に行こ!
lines.en: Next time let's match timing and go together!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
